newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile cenbank sees '98 inflation goal below 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chile cenbank sees '98 inflation goal below 5 pct.

text.p: Chile's Central Bank is planning to reduce its inflation target to less than five percent next year from 5.5 percent in 1997, said bank president Carlos Massad.
"The bank has started studying the target for next year. It will be less than five percent," Massad told a news conference.
The bank will reveal its next goal when the government presents details of next year's budget to Congress in September.
Chilean inflation fell to 6.6 percent last year from 8.2 percent in 1995.
Most economists expect inflation for this year to be about five percent, well below the official target of 5.5 to 6 percent. ((-- Margaret Orgill, santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
